summary: A member repeatedly takes the policy assignments colleagues pass up and becomes the person they turn to.
realLife: Riddick relayed a Republican Policy Committee staff director’s account of Robert Taft gaining influence by repeatedly agreeing to prepare the party’s case.
inGame: needs: policy committee assignments and completed work.

turns.what: The familiar lead shares the research.
turns.pulledBy: Another member volunteers for the next bill.
turns.writesBack: A new member presents the case.

turns.what: The chair divides the work around the table.
turns.writesBack: More than one member becomes responsible.
